description: No door takes a STATUS from params — status is the driver's, written through the edge table and nowhere else. The key is refused on reads too, so a client cannot even try to ask for 'merged' by typing it into the wrong place (includeTerminal is the honest door for history).

error.message: invalid params: mergequeue.list params carry "status" — the caller names what to act on, never who acted, what state the row is in, or what evidence it carries (S60 MQ13)
